market.title: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez — 2028 U.S. Presidential Election Winner
resolutionNote: Resolves to whoever is inaugurated President in January 2029, based on AP/Fox/NBC race calls.

text: AOC has become a genuine contender for 2028, regularly polling near or ahead of established names like Pete Buttigieg and Kamala Harris in early Democratic primary surveys.
She told ABC's This Week in August that she "hasn't ruled out" running for president, while also leaving open a Senate run against fellow New Yorker Chuck Schumer.
Ocasio-Cortez has increasingly been framed as heir to the movement built by Bernie Sanders, giving her a built-in base of grassroots support and fundraising infrastructure.
No formal campaign steps have been taken yet - by her own admission, she remains genuinely undecided between a presidential run, a Senate run, or neither.
marketBrief.author: Owain Flanders
